name: Aider
tagline: Aider is an open-source AI coding assistant that runs in your terminal and edits code directly in your local git repository. You describe what you want in natural language and Aider makes the changes, runs tests, and commits the result, working across multiple files simultaneously. Developers who prefer a keyboard-driven, local workflow over a cloud IDE use Aider as a powerful alternative to Cursor or Copilot.
